summary: KeystoneJS is a content management system and web application platform built with Node.js and distributed under the MIT licence. It provides a foundational structure for building backend services and managing digital content through code. Developers use its framework to model data schemas and generate administrative interfaces.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers looking to build custom web applications and content-driven platforms using a JavaScript-centric stack.
watchOut: Because it functions as a programmatic framework rather than a turnkey site builder, you will need to write custom code for frontend presentation and feature logic.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires a persistent server environment, a separate database backend, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
